# awesome-mcp-servers

> A curated catalog of working Model Context Protocol servers for Claude Desktop and other clients, labelled with publisher, runtime, and mutation capabilities.

The project is a static list maintained by Brethof AI, not a software library to install. It categorizes hundreds of MCP servers into sections like Web Search, Databases, and Operations, verifying that each entry is real, working, and honest. Entries are tagged with metadata indicating if they are official, community-made, read-only, mutating, local, or hosted.

## Docs

- [awesome-mcp-servers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/main/README.md): A catalog of verified, working MCP servers, labelled by publisher, runtime, and mutation capabilities.
- [Why this list exists](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#why-this-list-exists): Inclusion criteria for real, working, honest MCP servers, plus labeling rules for publishers, runtime, and payment methods.
- [Legend](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#legend): Definitions for labels indicating publisher type, mutation capability, runtime location, payment requirements, and listing recency.
- [Reference servers (MCP steering group)](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#reference-servers-mcp-steering-group): Official reference implementations from the MCP steering group, including filesystem, git, memory, and sequential thinking servers.
- [Files, Filesystem & Local Data](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#files-filesystem--local-data): Local MCP servers for file management, patch application, shell execution, and Obsidian vault note editing.
- [Web Search & Browsing](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#web-search--browsing): Official MCP servers for web search, library documentation retrieval, and public web page screenshot generation.
- [Browser Automation](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#browser-automation): MCP servers for browser automation, Chrome debugging, and comprehensive macOS system control and app interaction.
- [Source Control](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#source-control): Official MCP servers for managing repositories, issues, and pull requests on Gitea, GitHub, and GitLab.
- [Issue Trackers & Project Management](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#issue-trackers--project-management): Hosted MCP servers for managing tasks, projects, and issues in Asana, Atlassian, Linear, Orbit, and Trello.
- [Communication](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#communication): Desktop notifications, social media scheduling, and bulk publishing tools for agents and platforms.
- [Relational Databases](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#relational-databases): Official and community MCP servers for ClickHouse, MySQL, Postgres, and Supabase relational databases.
- [NoSQL & Document Databases](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#nosql--document-databases): Official MCP servers for MongoDB and Neo4j, supporting local and hosted database interactions.
- [Vector & Memory Stores](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#vector--memory-stores): Hosted knowledge bases and persistent memory stores for AI agents across sessions and projects.
- [Productivity & Notes](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#productivity--notes): MCP servers for Airtable, Apple Notes, Google Calendar, Notion, and Process Street productivity tools.
- [Design & Creative](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#design--creative): MCP servers for video editing, Figma design integration, and film reference libraries.
- [Operations & Infrastructure](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#operations--infrastructure): Official AWS, Azure, Cloudflare, and Datadog MCP servers for cloud infrastructure management and API access.
- [AI & ML Platforms](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#ai--ml-platforms): AI model monitoring, third-party app gateway, and API marketplace integrations for AI agents.
- [Specialised / Vertical](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#specialised--vertical): Local payment runtime for AI agents and read-only company information server for AIAgentCycle.
- [Frameworks & SDKs for Building MCP Servers](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#frameworks--sdks-for-building-mcp-servers): Python, Go, TypeScript, and community frameworks for building and deploying MCP servers.
- [Discovery hubs](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#discovery-hubs): Reference repositories, community lists, and hosted registries for discovering new MCP servers.
- [Related work](https://github.com/BrethofAI/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/README.md#related-work): Curated lists of AI coding agents, local AI tools, and privacy-focused AI architectures.
